Subject: Shift-credit exchange + skill triage for July hiring sprint

Hi all —

We have a compact hiring sprint next week for Payments Inc. (3 candidates across PM/Platform). Elliot flagged two late panel changes this morning and we need to rebalance interviewer load without stretching people too thin. Summary:

- Candidate schedule window: Wed 29 Jul — Fri 31 Jul (UTC-7 preferred)
- Panels: 3x interviews per candidate (system design, product sense, culture/fit)
- Skill gaps on current panel: backend systems depth, throughput testing, payments domain context

Ask: can anyone trade shift-credits or volunteer for a swap to cover a backend-heavy slot (system design)? If you trade, we credit you an extra 0.5 availability token for future sprints (internal accounting). Proposed mitigations in attachment 1: slot-matrix.xlsx (matrix of open slots vs skills). Attachment 2 is current-panel-list.csv.

If you volunteer but would like a mentor on the loop (to surface Redwood-specific scoring), propose a mentor pairing and well mark it in the tracker.

Quick constraints:
- Prefer minimal timezone hops for these candidates (PDT windows 10:00–15:00)
- Off-cycle swaps are OK if you can cover within 24 hours

Elliot / Samantha — FYI, we'll keep candidate-facing schedule intact; this is internal juggling.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
